The '''captain''' of a Republic [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] commanded forces along with [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] at the [[Battle of Jaga's Cluster]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Cassus Fett]] boarded the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that held the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] them in hand-to-hand combat, earning [[Gender/Legends|him]] much infamy.
